# Sample PostgreSQL schemas (morenoh149/postgresDBSamples)

Fixture SQL files are excerpts from [morenoh149/postgresDBSamples](https://github.com/morenoh149/postgresDBSamples) (Sample databases for PostgreSQL).

Used by pytest to verify we can parse real-world PostgreSQL DDL and generate synthetic data.

Source: `https://github.com/morenoh149/postgresDBSamples`  
Pagila: Movie rental database (PostgreSQL port of Sakila), e.g. `pagila-0.10.1/pagila-schema.sql`.
